annotations.title: Add an Internal Note to a Conversation

description: Add an internal note to a conversation — visible only to the merchant's team in the LetsBot inbox, never sent to the customer. Use it to leave context for colleagues (e.g. "customer wants a refund, waiting for the warehouse"). A note does not count as a reply to the customer. To alert teammates, mention them: write @Name in the body (e.g. "@Sara please call the customer") or pass their ids or names in "mentions" — each mentioned teammate is notified in the inbox and on their phone.

body.description: The note text (max 4000 characters). @Name mentions a teammate.

mentions.description: Optional teammates to notify: user ids (from get_moderators) or names, e.g. ["7", "Fatma"].

phone.description: Phone number (or chat id) of the contact.

name: add_note
